nodes.label: SyncEngine (drain + pull)
nodes.rationale: 401 stops draining as FAILURE to avoid an infinite retry storm and surface a check-settings state; IOException/5xx return RETRY keeping the op PENDING; 404 drops op and local row.

nodes.label: Offline-First Mutation Queue Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every mutation writes locally then enqueues a PendingOpEntity, so the UI never blocks on network and edits survive offline; a HiltWorker drains the queue through Retrofit then pulls and reconciles the server list.

nodes.label: Room as Single Source of Truth
nodes.norm_label: room as single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Room stays the single source of truth so UI reads are local-first and sync only mutates local state.

nodes.label: Last-Write-Wins Conflict Policy
nodes.rationale: Safe because single user + static token; a deliberate simplification since per-user accounts would require real conflict resolution.

nodes.label: Pull Sync Reconciliation (upsert by serverId, delete vanished rows unless protected)
nodes.norm_label: pull sync reconciliation (upsert by serverid, delete vanished rows unless protected)
nodes.rationale: Runs when the queue drains empty and on app open; rows whose serverId vanished remotely are deleted unless a pending op references them, protecting offline creates/edits.

nodes.label: UUID localId Primary Key Decision
nodes.rationale: PK stays the sample's localId String (UUID) so offline-created tasks exist before the server knows them; serverId links later.

nodes.label: Offline-First Mutation Queue
nodes.rationale: Every create/edit/complete/delete is queued locally and replayed by a WorkManager-driven SyncEngine so mutations never block on network.

nodes.label: Transactional Room Mutations
nodes.rationale: Wrap every mutation in a Room transaction writing the row and its pending op atomically; crash between separate calls loses data.

nodes.label: Domain-Local-Remote Model Boundary
nodes.rationale: One canonical Task domain model plus Room LocalTask and network TaskDto with a single mapping module, to eliminate duplicated mapping shapes.

nodes.label: Zero Behavior Change Constraint
nodes.rationale: Constraint honored throughout: zero behavior change, verified by characterization gates + full suite.

nodes.label: IN_PROGRESS Mapping Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: toExternal() derives status from legacy isCompleted flag only; changing it is a product decision, out of scope under no-behavior-change.

nodes.label: ISS-06
nodes.rationale: Gate re-scoped from queued-op wire format to identical HTTP request bodies, pinned by FakeApi wire-body canaries.

nodes.label: ISS-07
nodes.rationale: Accepted (not fixed): legacy queued ops fail once via existing error path, consistent with fallbackToDestructiveMigration practice.

nodes.label: ISS-08
nodes.rationale: Accepted: extra cached settings.session.first() read is pure with no observable behavior change.

nodes.label: updateCompleted Dead Code
nodes.rationale: TaskDao.updateCompleted had zero production callers; removed as dead code.

nodes.label: Widget Bypasses Repository
nodes.rationale: WidgetUpdater/TaskVaultWidget read TaskDao directly, the same anti-pattern this refactor removed from sync/.
